---

**Subject:** Response to Memo on Professional Conduct – Context and Commitment

Dear Mr. Prabhu Rajagopal,

Thank you for your memo dated 06-06-2025. I understand and acknowledge the importance of maintaining professionalism in the workplace and the impact communication can have on team morale and external perceptions.

I would like to sincerely clarify that any expression of frustration from my side has not been intended to undermine colleagues or company values, but has stemmed from ongoing challenges and unresolved concerns that have been affecting day-to-day work. My intention has always been to raise attention to issues that need resolution — not to create negativity or discomfort for the team.

That said, I take your feedback seriously and accept that how concerns are expressed is just as important as what is being addressed. I am committed to improving my communication tone and ensuring that future interactions are constructive, respectful, and in line with company expectations.

I would also welcome the opportunity to discuss some of the underlying issues contributing to this situation in a one-on-one meeting — either with you or my manager — to help prevent further misunderstandings and to support a healthier team dynamic.

Thank you for your understanding, and I look forward to working together to build a positive and productive environment.

Sincerely,  
**Thilaga Subha**

---
